title: Commission must hear consumer dispute
description: continue to hear all issues in a consumer dispute that could not be settled by mediation

content.who: District Commission or the State Commission or the National Commission
content.what: shall continue to hear all the issues involved in such consumer dispute
conditions: the consumer dispute could not be settled by mediation
limitations: the consumer dispute could not be settled by mediation
